_comment: Merge the 'hooks' key into .claude/settings.json of a THROWAWAY repo.
Three independent tests, each targeting a DIFFERENT dotnet command so the
handlers cannot interfere with one another:
dotnet --version       -> one handler, updatedInput with NO decision
dotnet --list-sdks     -> one handler, updatedInput WITH permissionDecision allow
dotnet --list-runtimes -> TWO handlers, both rewriting (composition test)
The composition pair is the interesting one. The hook-behaviour probe showed
all matching handlers run, so two rewriters can fire on one command. Whether
the second sees the first's output, the original, or whether one rewrite is
discarded, determines if a plugin may ever ship overlapping handlers.
